item.title: PortWin 1.27
item.description:
• Fixed disk space running out: Wine helper processes left behind after a crash could write the same error to a log endlessly (one user's log reached 137 GB). PortWin now stops such leftover processes and keeps every log small.
  • Steam, Epic, GOG Galaxy and Battle.net restarting themselves after an update is no longer treated as a crash.
  • "Fix automatically" no longer changes graphics for game launchers or in a bottle with a game whose graphics are known to work. Skyrim Special Edition stays on DXMT, and a banner offers to switch back if the graphics were changed.
  • Installers now default to drive C: — game repacks no longer offer Z:\Games and fail with "cannot write data to disk".
  • Shortcuts that installers put on the desktop are moved into the bottle instead of cluttering the Mac desktop, and installed programs are found by them.
